messages:
lucy: hi all  day 3 q's as i'm getting set up: who is the canonical owner of the "service owners" roster? who approves requests for GPU quota on Dedicated, and who should I page if a model publishing job causes customer regressions? also where's the short cheat-sheet for escalation contacts?

 tom: welcome lucy! :wave: people-ops keeps badge and building access, but the owners roster is maintained in the handbook doc under "service-ownership" (link pinned in #product). i'll DM you an owners snapshot with names + slack handles for your first week.

 raj: GPU quota and infra resource approvals go through eng-infra. open the infra access helper in #eng-infra or hit the slash helper:```/infra-request resource:gpu-cluster-2 quota:2 reason:"dev onboarding / testing"``` tag @raj for faster review. note: quotas on Dedicated often need a short justification and a cost owner.

 lucy: thanks  and for the owners roster, is there a minimal mapping i can keep in my notes (team -> who to ping)?

 felicia: short map: runtime -> @felicia (eng-runtime); infra -> @raj (eng-infra); api/gateway -> eng-platform; observability -> @cam (eng-sre); ml infra/modelops -> eng-ml. for customer-impacting issues start in #eng-runtime (they own model-serving) and loop eng-sre + support if it affects customers.

 cam: escalation tl;dr: 1) Triage in the owning channel 2) If it persists or is P1/P0, page oncall (use runbook for exact pager list) 3) If multi-team, create an incident and include support@redwood.com. Avoid paging nights for dev experiments 1 use staging and tag oncall if you need noisy tests. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/incident-flow

 lucy: good call on staging. if a model publish silently fails and customers start seeing stale outputs, who is first to page?

 felicia: page eng-runtime first. they check model version routing and serve code. eng-infra if the problem is infra-level (OOMs, autoscaler). eng-sre joins when alerts indicate customer error rates. if it's a publish pipeline failure, include eng-ml/modelops too.

 access-bot: [auto] infra-request created: IR-3328 (resource:gpu-cluster-2) 1 requester: lucy 1 reviewer: raj 1 status: pending.

 lucy: awesome  i'll paste IR-3328 into my ONBOARD-451 Jira. one last: any tips to avoid waking people during early testing? don't want to trigger pagers by accident.

 cam: good practice: mute prod alerting during experiments, use feature flags and run tests in a dedicated staging namespace. if you must test in prod, coordinate a quiet window with oncall via DM and record it in the runbook. also complete SEC-101 training to get full access.

 tom: i'll send you the owners snapshot and add you to the new-hire setup doc. ping me if badge pickup needs escalation. welcome aboard! :tada:
